newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE GRAINS LOWER, SHIPPER SELLING CITED.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE GRAINS LOWER, SHIPPER SELLING CITED.

text.p: LIFFE grains ended mostly lower on shipper selling, traders said.
On wheat, active January last traded 1.25 stg lower at 88.00 stg. January volume was 200 lots of a total 492.
Barley volume was limited to just 40 lots, with 35 on January. It last traded 0.75 stg lower at 82.50 stg.
Traders cited shipper selling, as the trigger for the fall. "Maybe it was a bit overbought last week," one said.
Although combines have been rolling accross England, there was little grain coming to market so far, and yields were reported to be down, the trader said.
The fall was despite a lower sterling, normally a trigger for price rises.
